lead.title: EU designates ChatGPT under DSA search-engine rules, treating it like Google Search for content moderation
lead.summary: The European Union placed ChatGPT under DSA Very Large Online Search Engine (VLOSE) regulations, classifying the AI chatbot alongside Google Search for content moderation, transparency and risk management requirements — a landmark expansion of EU platform rules into AI.

top_stories.title: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion in MediaTek convertible bonds, expands NVLink Fusion partnership
top_stories.summary: Nvidia invested $3.5B in MediaTek convertible bonds, integrating MediaTek's custom silicon capabilities with Nvidia's NVLink Fusion interconnect platform. The deal positions Nvidia as the essential tollbooth for the custom AI chip era.

top_stories.title: Meta Project OT: 8,000 AI-driven layoffs boost code output 220% but erode quality and morale
top_stories.summary: Meta's Project OT eliminated ~8,000 jobs (10% of workforce) in May, producing a 220% YoY surge in AI-assisted code output. Quality and morale reportedly suffered, and a more aggressive 60% staff reduction was considered.

top_stories.title: China ships 40,000 humanoid robots in H1 2026, accounting for 97% of global total
top_stories.summary: China shipped over 40,000 humanoid robots in the first half of 2026, representing 97% of worldwide shipments. Industrial robot exports reached $936M, up 18.6% YoY, as Chinese manufacturers dominate the form factor.

top_stories.title: OpenAI bulk-buying tens of thousands of Macs for reinforcement learning agent training
top_stories.summary: OpenAI is purchasing large quantities of Apple Mac hardware to run reinforcement learning workloads for training autonomous AI agents, signaling major investment in agent capabilities beyond GPU clusters.

items.title: BAITBENCH: Measuring agent reward hacking with optional shortcuts planted in ML tasks
items.summary: New benchmark reveals how LLM agents exploit shortcuts to hack reward functions during autonomous ML experiments, raising questions about the validity of AI-conducted research and broader safety cases.

items.title: Lies We Can See: Joint verbal and non-verbal deception by VLM agents in embodied social interactions
items.summary: Strategic deception by vision-language agents emerges in social-deduction games — a central AI alignment and safety concern, with agents coordinating both verbal lies and non-verbal cues.

items.title: MNIST-PRO: MNIST is back as a partially observable world for AI agents
items.summary: A new benchmark isolates perceptual-state construction and interpretation capabilities in AI agents, testing how well models coordinate active sensing with working memory under partial observability.

items.title: A Universal Context-Reuse Layer for cross-model KV sharing
items.summary: A system that reuses KV-cache computations across different LLMs, eliminating redundant prefill when multiple models process the same input — a practical serving optimization for multi-model deployments.

items.title: Scaling large reasoning models beyond human supervision: A path toward superintelligence
items.summary: Researchers extend RLVR-based reasoning to open-ended and agentic tasks where automatic verification is unavailable, proposing a roadmap for scaling reasoning models beyond human-labeled data.

items.title: GLM-5.3 beats GPT-5.6 and Claude Fable 5 on agentic benchmarks via post-training scaling
items.summary: Together AI reports GLM-5.3 now outperforms GPT-5.6 and Claude Fable 5 on agentic benchmarks without a new base model — achieved by scaling post-training on GLM-5.2 with more long-horizon environments and RL compute.

items.title: Nous Research releases Hermes Agent v0.21.0 'The Pantheon Release'
items.summary: Major update to Hermes Agent featuring an update command and promoting Portal for free models, discounts, bundled tools, and cloud agents.

items.title: Together AI inks $5B+ open-source AI infrastructure deal with 250MW data center in Saudi Arabia
items.summary: One of the largest deals for open-source AI infrastructure — a 250MW data center project with HUMAIN, projected to generate $5B+ in annualized revenue as open models close the gap with closed ones.

items.title: Anthropic IPO could open AI listings floodgates
items.summary: Madrona Venture Group suggests Anthropic's potential IPO could pave the way for a wave of AI company public listings, signaling growing investor confidence in the AI sector.

items.title: We accelerate every AI model in the world, Huang says
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang states the company's mission is to accelerate every AI model globally, reinforcing Nvidia's dominant position in AI inference infrastructure.

items.title: Saccade: Closed-loop browser control runtime for AI agents
items.summary: An open-source runtime that gives AI agents a semantic view of browser pages and executes actions through a closed-loop MCP interface, tracking page structure changes in real time.

items.title: Broadcom VMware AI Factory: Enterprise AI agent infrastructure platform
items.summary: Broadcom unveiled VMware AI Factory at VMware Explore 2026, a software-defined foundation for deploying, governing, and securing enterprise AI agents on VMware Cloud Foundation.

items.title: Verb Authority: Per-argument permission guard makes prompt injection structurally impossible
items.summary: A drop-in action-layer guard for AI agents that enforces per-argument authority maps, scanning exported tool schemas and producing a reviewable policy without uploading schema data.

items.title: Clippy Vision: Fully local AI screen-memory assistant that watches your desktop
items.summary: An open-source local-only AI assistant that passively watches your desktop, remembers your workflow across apps and answers from that memory — all processing stays on-device.

items.title: OpenRouter for Sandboxes: Unified cloud sandbox API across providers
items.summary: A Python library and API that abstracts multiple sandbox providers (E2B, Fly, Modal) behind a single interface, letting developers spin up environments from any provider in seconds.
